thread:
deploy-bot: Canary finished for rollout/2026-04-14 (variant v2.3.1). Summary: overall success, but noticed a small sustained p95 latency delta on embed-route in eu-west1 (+18ms) and a mismatch between synth-kv probe and heartbeat probe. Attaching quick stats.

deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: p50 43ms, p95 128ms (+18ms vs baseline), error rate 0.06%, synth-kv success 99.8%, heartbeat-ok 100%.

maya: saw this in dashboards. p95 bump is consistent across 3 hosts, but tail isn't spiking—looks like amplification at 512-token prompts.

sam: @maya thanks. Do we have correlating infra events? node restarts, GC, network?

jin: nothing in infra-alerts. I checked node-exporter on the three hosts — cpu/alloc and mem look normal. Network tx/rx no anomalies.

ops-bot: Recorded deploy window: 2026-04-14T14:05Z -> 14:12Z, canary weight ramp OK. No autoscaler or machine churn detected.

maya: here's a quick query I ran against traces: 
```
select trace_id, p95_latency_ms, seq_len from traces where route='embed-route' and time > '2026-04-14T14:00Z' order by p95_latency_ms desc limit 10;
# result: several with seq_len >= 500 and kernel_variant=quant2
```

sam: so higher seq_len + quant2 path maybe interacts to add ~15-20ms. Is that within our release SLO tolerance?

jin: SLO slack for canary is p95 <= 140ms. We're at 128ms. So technically pass, but the delta is new. Ops wants to know if we should pin a rollback or pin routing.

maya: my hunch: safe to continue, but add a short hold and increase sampling of 512+ prompts to watch tail. If we see >30ms drift or error increase, we pin.

sam: propose: HOLD for 30m, enable verbose synth sampling for long prompts, and run quick replay against previous model variant (v2.3.0) on 10% shadow traffic for comparison. If v2.3.0 p95 < v2.3.1 by >20ms => rollback pin. Otherwise continue rollout. Thoughts?

jin: +1 for hold and shadow compare. I can spin shadow for 10% on eu-west1 and route tester. Also add circuit-breaker threshold to auto-fallback for that route if errors >0.2% or p95>160ms.

deploy-bot: Action logged: hold_rollout for rollout/2026-04-14 by sam. Shadow test: creating 10% shadow in eu-west1. Verbose synth sampling enabled for embed-route (512+). Auto-fallback policy attached: p95>160ms or error_rate>0.2%.

ops-bot: Noted; adding notification to #eng-sre and #product-incidents if auto-fallback triggers.

maya: I'll collect a 15m sample and paste a short diff. If tail evolves, we can either tweak quant config (quant2 -> quant1) for that allocation or pin traffic back to v2.3.0.

sam: keep messages here. If shadow shows parity, we'll lift the hold after 30m. If not, escalate to rollback pin.

jin: started shadow job at 14:28Z. ETA ~4m for warm cache.

maya: initial 5m sample: v2.3.1 p95=129ms, v2.3.0 shadow p95=112ms (same host subset). Error rates equal. Will continue to watch.

sam: thanks. That's borderline. Continue 30m hold. If at any point p95 gap >25ms OR error_rate gap >0.1% -> pin and roll back.

deploy-bot: 14:40Z update: shadow comparison (10m): v2.3.1 p95=131ms, v2.3.0 p95=113ms. Gap 18ms. No error gap. Hold continues.

maya: filing a short runbook note for ops: potential quant2/seq_len interaction. If gap persists after 30m, recommend a targeted hotfix that changes kernel selection for long sequences in eu-west1 or revert to v2.3.0.

sam: agreed. Schedule: hold until 14:58Z. If after 14:58Z gap <=15ms -> resume rollout. If gap >25ms or errors increase -> rollback pin.

jin: I'll leave synthetic alerts at higher frequency for the hold window. Also I enabled a trace sampler filter for seq_len>=512 so we get better signal.

ops-bot: Escalation channel configured. If deploy-bot triggers fallback, it will also create an incident stub in incidents channel.

maya: thanks all. will post final sample at 14:56Z. 

sam: good plan, team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Final hold-window check at 14:56Z: rolling 15m p95 delta = 17ms, no error rate regression. Decision: resume rollout to 100% at 14:59Z per sam. Action: lift_hold.

jin: lifting monitoring throttle back to normal. No follow-on alerts.

maya: will open a tiny postmortem note in release notes: mention transient tail drift in eu-west1 for long prompts, recommended follow-up = add a microbenchmark in CI for seq_len 512+ on quant2 kernels.

sam: capture that in the release notes and assign to runtime team for a follow-up ticket. Good catch everyone.
